description: This file defines the VtigerWebserviceObject class, which manages the retrieval and caching of web service entity metadata within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods to create instances from entity name, ID, or query, and provides accessors for entity properties.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Represents a web service entity with methods to retrieve its metadata and cache instances based on name or ID.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Retrieves a VtigerWebserviceObject instance based on the entity's name, utilizing a cache to avoid redundant database queries.

methods.name: fromId
methods.description: Retrieves a VtigerWebserviceObject instance based on the entity's ID, utilizing a cache for efficiency.

methods.name: fromQuery
methods.description: Parses a SQL query to extract the entity name and returns the corresponding VtigerWebserviceObject.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity.

methods.name: getHandlerPath
methods.description: Returns the handler path associated with the entity.

methods.name: getHandlerClass
methods.description: Returns the handler class associated with the entity.
